services.name: 2 Hour Shell Island Dolphin Boat Tour
services.desc: Get up close and personal with the dolphins on this super fun boat tour! Designed to get you out there in the water swimming with the dolphins, snorkeling (gear included), explore shell island and enjoy the beautiful St. Andrews Bay! Duration 2 hours About A more intimate Dolphin experience, just a small group (the boat can hold up to 6 passengers), our dolphin Boat Tours are 2 hours in length and offer you the opportunity to swim with dolphins, explore Shell Island and snorkel for sand dollars. Get your own private tour. Our captains are experienced and knowledgeable when it comes to finding the best spots to see Dolphins. Boat Tours are fun for the entire family, no matter what their age.
